modules.name: graph-edges
modules.purpose: Typing edges and nodes in a graph or knowledge network. MARKED SUSPECT: relationship judgements are inherently relational, and P21 says those sit in the mid band. Test before trusting. Original recombine rule (prose, not yet a decision rule): DO NOT SHIP AS-IS. Measured 2026-09-19 on 16 real pairs: `relationship` is only MARGINAL (38% at the ends, mean confidence 0.465) and both of its former gating questions failed outright. Until the relationship question itself is sharpened — disjoint criteria, or a narrower relation set — this set accepts almost nothing cleanly. Treat a confident `relationship` as a candidate, derive direction from the static table, and escalate provenance to a text model.

relationship.instructions: Reading the two items in the state, which relationship does the FIRST have to the SECOND?

criteria.depends_on: The first cannot work or make sense without the second.
criteria.specialises: The first is a narrower case of the second.
criteria.contradicts: They cannot both be true or both be done.
criteria.mentions: The first merely refers to the second.

relationship.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

compose.positive: an edge type per candidate pair, with a review flag

notForJev.judgement: Is the relationship directional — would it be false if the two items were swapped?
notForJev.instead: A STATIC TABLE keyed by the relationship label, because directionality is a property of the label and not of the pair: depends_on → directional, specialises → directional, mentions → directional, contradicts → symmetric, unrelated → n/a. Measured at **0% at the ends** across 16 pairs, mean confidence 0.208 — the worst result in the whole bank. It asks for a counterfactual ("if these were swapped"), which cannot be read off one state.

notForJev.judgement: Is this relationship stated explicitly, or did you infer it?
notForJev.instead: A text-model call, and ONLY on edges that already cleared the relationship question's confident band. Asking it of every candidate pair is what drove it to 6% at the ends. Provenance-of-a-claim is P21 shape.

notForJev.judgement: Does this edge create a cycle?
Is this edge redundant given the others?
notForJev.instead: Transitive reduction in code. It sees one pair at a time.

notForJev.judgement: Which of these 50 candidate edges are real?
notForJev.instead: One call per pair, then threshold. No cross-pair comparison exists.
